title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 1: Bar Chart – Household Recycling Rates in Four Cities
prompt: The bar chart below shows the percentage of household waste recycled in four cities (A, B, C and D) in the years 2005, 2015 and 2025. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请先仔细阅读图表，注意不同城市在三个年份的回收率变化。写作时请概括主要特征并进行比较，不要加入个人观点或原因分析。建议用20分钟完成，写至少150词。
